notes.title: Ourea is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37184300/36353653a77a32516d062e0fc3d47e420690403d.png[/img]

Ourea is out now! We would like to thank everyone for their support and their feedback over the last few months, we really appreciate it. We have worked very hard to release this game and we cant wait to hear what yous think!

notes.title: Ourea - Discover the harrowing past of a long forgotten world
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37184300/9942ab4008a0d2af37db131181e6c896b7762d06.gif[/img]


Play through the first fifteen minutes and discover the mystical, hand-painted world of Ourea.
In this demo, you'll get to experience one of our environmental puzzles as well as our cinematic style of a single unbroken shot. Ourea is the first game by the award-winning Irish-based Rewrite Games. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37184300/9d7643461ea750e3a22e0e5f089a290effa02ca8.gif[/img]


We're really excited to be part of the festival and for you to play our demo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1250030/Ourea/
